About a month ago /u/HomerSimpson (pbuh) brought to my attention to case of 8chan, where the owner lost control of his website and company due to an untrustworthy registrar who siezed control of the domain after a sustained attack and pressure from external sources. More info here. I love the .mg domain, it's unique and short but there is the potential that it could face the same problems as 8chan.co.

To mitigate this potential problem we purchased an additional domain, ioIMG.com, .com domains are operated by the American company Verisign which likely has much stronger intellectual property protections than the Madagascar run .mg domain.

ioIMG is just an alternative, the site uses the same databases and servers, the only difference between these two sites is the name. If you have an account on sli.mg it is accessible from the alternate domain.

This also means that if Sli.mg is blocked at your place of work or is not resolving properly for whatever reason just replace it with ioIMG.com and it will work.

e.g. https://sli.mg/4Wq4sr.png

change to

https://ioimg.com/4Wq4sr.png

Additionally we have added to our list of features to develop both chrome and firefox extensions which will automatically redirect you if you have problems accessing sli.mg regularly.

At one point I didnt have enough money for a new mattress, and so I made a bed on the floor with my blankets. It was an incredibly positive experience in my life. Doctors recommend laying on the floor if you have back pain, because our bodies have been laying on the cold hard ground for millions of years now. Its only been recently that we started sleeping on soft fluffy mattress, designed to feel like clouds. And I tell you, it felt great laying on the floor feeling my spine adjust the way it was meant to be. Imagine laying down with good posture for 8 hours every night vs 8 hours of comfort for 8 hours. It also cleared up TONS of space in my room. In the morning I could just throw my blankets and pillow into the closet and open up my room to actual free movement.

But the downside is that everyone will think youre a weird crazy soon to be homeless person ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
